content.json:
# Cost & Usage

Log Analytics workspace ingestion, data retention costs, Application Insights consumption, and optimization opportunities.

content.title: Daily Billable Ingestion (GB)

content.query:
// Ingestion by data type (top 15)
Usage
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where IsBillable == true
| summarize IngestedGB = sum(Quantity) / 1000.0 by DataType
| order by IngestedGB desc
| take 15
content.title: Ingestion by Data Type (Top 15)

content.query:
// Ingestion by computer (top 20 talkers)
Usage
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where IsBillable == true
| extend Computer = tostring(split(_ResourceId, '/')[(-1)])
| summarize IngestedGB = sum(Quantity) / 1000.0 by Computer
| order by IngestedGB desc
| take 20
content.title: Top 20 Data Sources by Volume

content.query:
// Workspace commitment tier utilization
Usage
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where IsBillable == true
| summarize DailyIngestGB = sum(Quantity) / 1000.0
| extend
    CommitmentTier100 = iif(DailyIngestGB >= 100, 'Eligible', 'Under'),
    CommitmentTier200 = iif(DailyIngestGB >= 200, 'Eligible', 'Under'),
    CommitmentTier300 = iif(DailyIngestGB >= 300, 'Eligible', 'Under'),
    CommitmentTier500 = iif(DailyIngestGB >= 500, 'Eligible', 'Under')
content.title: Commitment Tier Eligibility (Last 24h)

content.query:
// Tables with basic log potential (low query, high volume)
Usage
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where IsBillable == true
| summarize IngestedGB = sum(Quantity) / 1000.0, QueryCount = 0 by DataType
| where IngestedGB > 1
| order by IngestedGB desc
| project DataType, IngestedGB, Recommendation = 'Evaluate for Basic Logs tier'
content.title: Basic Logs Candidates (High Volume Tables)

content.query:
// App Insights sampling effectiveness
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| summarize
    SampledCount = count(),
    EstimatedTotal = sum(ItemCount)
  by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| extend SamplingRatio = round(toreal(SampledCount) / toreal(EstimatedTotal) * 100, 2)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: App Insights Sampling Effectiveness
